# Motion Count Up

KPI numbers that count up from zero when they scroll into view, formatted in the user's locale. One figure (partial) or a responsive row of figures (report).

| | |
|---|---|
| Plug-in type | templateComponent |
| Static ID | `AMC_MOTION_COUNT_UP` |
| APEXlang reference | `type: plugin/motionCountUp` |
| Modes | partial (single / report column), report (multiple rows) |
| Minimum APEX | 23.1 (APEXlang import: 26.1+) |
| Version | 1.0.0 |

Map Value to a numeric column, using a period as decimal separator. The final value is in the page markup, so screen readers, printing and users with reduced motion get it directly; the count-up only animates what is shown.

## Settings

| APEXlang setting | Builder label | Type | Required | Default | Notes |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `value` | Value | sessionStateValue | yes |  | Numeric value to count up to, for example 1284500 or 98.6. Use a period as decimal separator. |
| `label` | Label | sessionStateValue |  |  | Caption under the number, for example Orders this year. |
| `prefix` | Prefix | sessionStateValue |  |  | Text before the number, for example a currency symbol. |
| `suffix` | Suffix | sessionStateValue |  |  | Text after the number, for example %, k or SAR. |
| `icon` | Icon | sessionStateValue |  |  | Optional Font APEX icon class, for example fa-shopping-cart. |
| `decimals` | Decimal Places | selectList (`one`, `two`) |  |  | Digits after the decimal separator. Leave empty for whole numbers. |
| `duration` | Duration | selectList (`short`, `long`) |  |  | How long the count takes. Leave empty for 1.6 seconds. |
| `accent` | Accent | selectList (`primary`, `success`, `warning`, `danger`) |  |  | Colors the number and icon with the theme palette. Leave empty for the default text color. |

## Install

- **APEX 26.1+ with APEXlang:** copy `dist/apexlang/shared-components/plugins/motion-count-up/` into your app's `shared-components/plugins/`, then run the apexlang skill's format, compiler-truth and runtime validate gates.
- **APEX 23.1 to 25.x (or any version, via App Builder):** import `dist/legacy/amc_motion_count_up.sql` from Shared Components > Plug-ins > Import.
